decisions.reason: The flow-rate refinement does not change the candidate's open/close actuation mechanism.
Avoiding slow or explosive pouring does not modify the independent leak-containment requirement.
The controlled flow-rate constraint does not change the required barista-facing spout orientation.
The flow-rate refinement does not change the spout removal or flushing requirement.
Pour speed does not alter the requirement that the bottom seal prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The flow-rate constraint may inform component selection but does not change the BOM deliverable or sourcing strategy.
The dispensing flow-rate refinement does not change bowl depth or capacity geometry.
The dispensing flow-rate refinement has no effect on the branded title text.
The flow-rate constraint does not modify enclosure size or side-profile proportions.
The controlled stream requirement does not change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The dispensing flow-rate refinement does not change the green accent color.
Although an explosive pour could cause mess, the source decision does not modify the existing mixing-splash control target.
